strategies.name: htf_fvg_tap_with_1m_ifvg_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: After 9:30 a.m. New York time, identify the draw on liquidity, wait for a 5-minute or 15-minute fair value gap to form in the direction of that draw, then wait for price to tap that higher-timeframe fair value gap. On the 1-minute chart, require a liquidity sweep and then an inversion of the 1-milee
strategies.exit_summary: Enter as soon as price closes through the 1-minute fair value gap inversion. Place the stop beyond the sweep/high-low that defines the reversal, target either the draw on liquidity or more consistently a fixed 1:2 risk-reward, and move the stop to breakeven once the closest post-entry liquidity has:
